content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CUTN Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CUTN Medical Officer (Male) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CUTN Medical Officer Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 1 vacancy is available – 1 for the Medical Officer (Male) (On Temporary Engagement) post.

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Recognized Medical Degree (MBBS) of any University and Registered with the Indian Medical Council/NMC and completion of rotating internship.

content_sections.heading: CUTN Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 09-08-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Medical Officer (Male) post at CUTN?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Medical Officer (Male) position at Central University of Tamil Nadu is 09-08-2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Medical Officer (Male) role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Recognized Medical Degree (MBBS) from any University, be registered with the Indian Medical Council/NMC, and have completed a rotating internship.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Medical Officer (Male) post is 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Medical Officer (Male) position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 65,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Medical Officer (Male) vacancy?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your bio-data, attach necessary documents, and send it to the specified email address before the deadline.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Medical Officer (Male) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for this position will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contract job?
faq.answer: The job is on a contract basis, as indicated by the job type being listed as 'Contract'.

faq.question: Q9. Which university is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Central University of Tamil Nadu (CUTN).

faq.question: Q10. Where is the Central University of Tamil Nadu located?
faq.answer: The Central University of Tamil Nadu is located in Thiruvarur, Tamil Nadu, with the pincode 610005.
